standard_prerequisites.name: The sequence of solutions U_n
standard_prerequisites.reference: The sequence of solutions U_n(z;alpha,beta) of the v-ODE with their power-series expansions, the auxiliary coefficient sequences bounding them, the recurrence relations for the coefficients, and the Painleve III(D8) equation with its unique analytic solution.
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies background that the delivered proof uses. The entry is declared as a dependency; it is not re-proved on the card, and the load-bearing steps of the counted statement are carried out inside the delivered span.

core_obligations: Assume the U_n are analytic at the origin and that U_n(0;alpha,beta) tends to a non-zero limit. Prove that for some radius rho and all large n the U_n are analytic on |z| < rho and converge uniformly there to the unique analytic solution U of Painleve III(D8) with that value at the origin.
proof_roadmap: Step 1: define the majorant sequence Upsilon_k from the limit value and compare the coefficient inequalities to get |v_{n,k}| <= Upsilon_k for all large n and every k. Step 2: show that for each fixed k the coefficients v_{n,k} tend to a limit v_{inf,k}, still bounded by Upsilon_k. Step 3: obtain convergence of U_n to a limiting analytic function by dominated convergence. Step 4: pass to the limit termwise in the differential equation to see that the limit solves Painleve III(D8), and pass to the limit in the recurrence relations for uniqueness.
